title: Cleaning Cycle Required
fullDescription: Krups super-auto signals cleaning every ~360 brews. Run cleaning tablet cycle.

title: Descale Required
fullDescription: Krups counter triggers descale. Use F054 descaler.

title: Tank or Brew Unit Issue
fullDescription: Brew unit missing or not seated.

title: Water Circuit Issue
fullDescription: Pump cannot prime. Run hot water dispense to clear air.

title: Grinder Jam
fullDescription: Foreign object in grinder. Empty hopper and clear.

title: Fill Water Tank
fullDescription: Reservoir below min or float stuck.

title: Drip Tray Overflow
fullDescription: Drip tray full from rinse cycles. Empty.

title: Milk Frother Not Frothing
fullDescription: Milk circuit clogged with dried milk.
